knownIssues.text: BMW issued a connecting-rod bearing service action for specified E46 M3 production dates. Coverage depends on the individual VIN.
BMW published repair procedures for cracking at the rear axle carrier support. Inspection should cover the body attachment area.
The S54 VANOS exhaust drive hardware is an inspection point. Specialist service information describes worn or damaged drive components.

prevention.text: Verify rod-bearing campaign history and ask a BMW specialist to inspect the rear carrier support and VANOS system.

mechanicalComplexity.text: An electrohydraulic system operates the clutch and gear selection. It adds hardware and diagnostic labor relative to the factory manual.

driving.text: Fast paddle shifts suit a committed pace. Low-speed shifts are less fluent than the factory manual's and ask for adjustment.

styling.text: The SMG shares the wide-arched coupe body and visual balance of the factory manual.

character.enthusiastAppeal: The S54 adds engine character to a practical coupe format.
character.idealBuyer: A driver who wants a usable sports coupe and can budget for specialist inspection and repairs.
character.avoidIf: You need a predictable low maintenance budget.
